## FINAL REPORT — rebar-debug, closed 2026-08-05

**Problem.** Plan-review Pass-2 `prerequisite_verify` failed on Bedrock with HTTP 400
`ValidationException` ("Grammar compilation timed out" / "Schema is too complex"), degrading every
finding to `no-verification`.

**Proven root cause.** Story [rebar:18ae-27e9-b651-4b71] (commit `6c8daf7945`, 08-05 00:48) added an
exact-model-id row setting `native_structured_output=True` for `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6`.
Applied AFTER the `_is_claude -> False` family rule, it WINS, flipping the model from PromptedOutput
to NativeOutput — so rebar began sending Bedrock each contract's JSON Schema to compile into a
decoding grammar. Anthropic documents a 180s compilation timeout and a 24-optional-parameter cap;
the verification contracts carry 22-36 optional parameters (every field declares `default=`, so
every field is optional in JSON Schema).

**Proof (discriminating, one variable at a time, live us-east-1, serial).**
tiny contract + NATIVE -> OK 2.0s; `plan_review_verification` + NATIVE -> FAIL 185.3s; the IDENTICAL
payload + PROMPTED -> OK 11.2s. Rivals killed: not flakiness (27 failures, duration pinned
180.6-185.9s), not load (serial, idle account), not plan content (two very different plans), not
finding count (withdrawn — see the correction comment), not byte size (descriptions stripped
8719->2403 B still FAILS while a 4022 B contract PASSES).

**Test.** `tests/unit/test_schema_complexity_gate.py` — written RED-first, moved OUT of the
implementing agent's tree and never seen by it. 6/6 GREEN after the fix. Teeth proven by TWO
defect-seeded mutations: bypassing the complexity bound reddens the two contract tests while the
other four stay green (discriminating, not blanket-failing); removing the variant-B rule reddens
exactly that test. Honesty note recorded IN the file: the two variant-B cases were added after the
implementation, so they are mutation-verified rather than RED-first.

**Fix** (merged `d8adf0f5654`). `output_mode` gates NativeOutput on (a) whether the installed stack
can send `outputConfig` at all, then (b) a measured complexity bound (16 optional / 12 union, inside
the measured 14-passes/22-fails gap). A BOUND, not a disable: exactly the three measured-failing
contracts downgrade, the other 16 stay native. The counting walker dereferences `$defs` and descends
`items`/nested `properties` — load-bearing, because `VerificationOutput` has ONE top-level property,
so a top-level-only count would score these at 0-1 and silently fix nothing. `failure.py` classifies
both rejection shapes distinctly; `structured_run` falls back to the existing prompted path.

**Scope & safety.** Caller sweep: exactly ONE `NativeOutput(...)` construction site and ONE
`output_type=` call site in `src/`, so the gate covers every channel (CLI, MCP, library, review bot).
Restores behaviour rather than creating any; no new dependency; no existing test weakened, skipped
or xfailed. 18ae's own pins still pass. The single full-suite failure
(`test_full_backend_account_is_present`) was verified PRE-EXISTING on a stashed clean tree.

**Siblings.** Construct sweep: the same defect class reaches `code_review_verification` (36
optionals, MEASURED FAIL 185.4s), pinned `model: standard` in `gates/code-review.yaml` — i.e. the
Gerrit `LLM-Review` gate. Fixed by the same change, and pinned by a parametrized case. The haiku row
carries the identical hazard and is covered too, because the gate is model-agnostic. Parity census:
one construction site, no MISSING slots.

**Replication.** `rebar review-plan 895c` BEFORE: INDETERMINATE, `verify_failed=true`, blocking 0,
indeterminate 6, one live 400. AFTER: **PASS**, 0 grammar 400s, 0 prerequisite-verifier failures.
The original report no longer reproduces.

**Residual risk — every item dispositioned.**
* [rebar:2391-a941-69ff-4645] `overlap-judge` failing at 312-381s with `requests=3` — a DISTINCT
  mode (different step, non-overlapping duration band, completed requests vs `requests=0`). Ticket
  filed, linked.
* [rebar:2876-7958-8dee-4882] the direct-Anthropic fallback arm 401s in 0.4s, so a Bedrock rejection
  has no runtime rescue. Ticket filed, linked.
* [rebar:4136-a38d-7b33-4b9d] a verified description write silently reverted mid-review; read-back
  verification PASSED before the loss. Secondhand, filed anyway. Linked.
* AC3 (partial credit for a failed verify) — closed WON'T FIX per operator.
* Botocore on the main checkout (1.40.61) — ACCEPTED as an operator action, not a code fix:
  upgrading to >=1.43.64 removes variant B independently of this change.

**Why this close is a force.** The completion verifier LOOPS on this ticket
([rebar:c827-2a23-cd00-473e]): 240/240 requests, 255 tool calls, 74 distinct, one `search_files`
signature repeated 175 times, 712.9s. Second occurrence today. So this close records operator
authorization plus verified delivery — NOT a passing completion verification.
